baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive opening, the predicate 'brothers,' and the fa-linked command to repair the between.
baseline_models.mechanism: Belief supplies settled security, brotherhood supplies kinship and a tether, and conflict damages the interval that also connects the parties. Reconciliation restores that relational medium; the fa makes repair an entailment of believing identity rather than optional charity.

activation_trace.role: Settled security makes belief the trust substrate that conflict endangers.
Kinship turns the disputants into relations whose bond survives disagreement.
The tether image makes brotherhood an operative bond rather than a resemblance.
Removal of interpersonal estrangement supplies the repair action.
The connection between parties identifies the relation itself as the repair site.

changed_reading.before: Believers happen to be brothers and should settle their quarrels.
changed_reading.after: The identity 'believers' names a trust-bearing tether whose damaged between the community is obligated to restore.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Repair is followed by protective caution toward God and then by hoped-for mercy.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse sequences relational repair, the erection of a protective barrier, and hoped-for tenderness. Mercy does not dissolve boundaries: guarded conduct preserves the conditions in which kinship can receive mercy.

activation_trace.role: Restoring soundness initiates the sequence by opposing relational corruption.
A barrier that wards off harm makes caution protective rather than merely fearful.
Self-placement in caution assigns each addressee responsibility for maintaining the barrier.
Tender mercy is the hoped-for condition beyond guarded repair.
The kinship branch loops the promised mercy back into the brother relation.

changed_reading.before: Fear God after making peace so that God may reward you with mercy.
changed_reading.after: Protective God-conscious conduct keeps repaired kinship habitable; mercy is the enclosing condition hoped for, not a substitute for boundaries.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A plural believing collective is named as siblings, while the concrete breach is dual and the repair command remains plural.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse scales from the whole collective to a two-sided interface and back to the wider addressees. The pair owns the dispute, but the surrounding community owns responsibility for repairing the middle and preserving its connection.

activation_trace.role: Repeated sibling language carries one collective identity into the concrete pair.
The middle interval localizes where a collective fracture becomes actionable.
The connecting tie keeps the localized pair attached to the larger body.
Reconciliation supplies the collective action applied to the dyadic breach.

changed_reading.before: Two disputants privately need to make up.
changed_reading.after: Every pairwise rupture is a live interface in the collective, so the plural community bears a repair duty without erasing the pair's distinct sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence checks forward advance, elevated voice, access across an enclosure, and impatience. Activated against the repair command, mediation becomes a boundary-sensitive craft in which repairers first limit their own pace, volume, and access so intervention does not become another breach.

activation_trace.role: Forward precedence marks premature intervention as an overstep to be restrained.
Voice elevation supplies an acoustic form of domination that can damage repair.
Deliberate lowering and withholding model the mediator's self-limitation.
An enclosed place makes access and relational boundaries materially visible.
Holding the self against panic supplies the temporal discipline of waiting.
The focus command is the action whose method is revised by the restraint sequence.

structural_cues: 49:1-5 move from not advancing through voice control and chamber boundaries to waiting before the focus repair command.
The focus command addresses a plural audience, leaving room for the preceding discipline to govern would-be mediators.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an ordered restraint sequence and concrete boundary images; I infer that this discipline governs how the plural addressees mediate in 49:10. A live alternative is that the sequence concerns prophetic etiquette only and does not generalize to reconciliation.

changed_reading.before: Repair means stepping in decisively to stop a quarrel.
changed_reading.after: Repair first disciplines the intervener: do not outrun authority, amplify yourself, invade an enclosure, or force timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: An incoming report is followed by making matters appear clearly, lest impulsive ignorance strike people and leave regret. The shared B-Y-N field turns the focus 'between' from a gap to close quickly into a relation that must first be made intelligible.

activation_trace.role: A delivered report supplies the uncertain informational input to conflict.
Appearance and disclosure turn verification into the first repair operation.
Disturbed forbearance shows ignorance as reactive volatility, not only missing data.
Regret supplies the irreversible cost of acting before clarification.
The focus connection is what premature, unverified action would damage.
Reconciliation becomes the downstream operation after facts are exposed.

structural_cues: 49:6 orders report, clarification, possible injury, and regret as a causal sequence.
B-Y-N occurs as clarification in 49:6 and as the relational middle in 49:10.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the report-to-regret sequence and two B-Y-N realizations; I infer a procedural arrow from disclosure to sound reconciliation. A live alternative is that verification governs only sanctions, while ordinary mediation could proceed without this epistemic phase.

changed_reading.after: Sound reconciliation first clears what happened; closing an opaque gap can preserve error and injure the very connection being repaired.

context_deltas.mechanism: Faith is made beloved and beautiful within hearts, then named as gift, while wisdom includes restraint for correction. The focus brotherhood therefore has an affective engine: repair externalizes a divinely formed attraction to trust and aversion to corruption rather than merely enforcing a label.

activation_trace.role: Heart-abiding love supplies the attraction that can draw parties back toward trust.
Making goodness appear beautiful supplies positive affective formation, not bare compliance.
The heart locates that formation in the inward center from which social conduct proceeds.
Gift and beneficence prevent repaired disposition from becoming self-authored merit.
Restraint that turns back for correction gives formed desire a governing edge.
Trusting assent anchors the inward formation back in the focus identity.

structural_cues: 49:7 uses causative affective verbs around faith, hearts, aversion, and right guidance; 49:8 calls the result gift and favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inward love, adornment, aversion, and gift; I infer that this affective formation enables the outward repair duty. A live alternative is that 49:7-8 describes guidance generally without specifying reconciliation as its expression.

changed_reading.before: Brotherhood is a legal category that imposes reconciliation from outside.
changed_reading.after: The category has an inward motor: repaired social conduct manifests a gifted desire for trust and a trained aversion to corrupting the bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding case begins with mutual fighting, but once one side crosses the limit the community confronts that side until it returns; only then is the between repaired with justice and equity. Brotherhood survives violence, yet it cannot be used to flatten agency or demand symmetrical concessions from aggressor and injured party.

activation_trace.role: Combat between sides supplies both the initial mutual conflict and the later coercive intervention.
Repeated removal of estrangement brackets the accountability phase without replacing it.
Crossing the limit through aggression identifies a non-symmetrical source of harm.
Return and turning back define the transition from resistance to renewed settlement.
Justice in judgment governs the second reconciliation rather than equalized blame.
Equity gives repaired order an affirmative measure beyond mere cessation.
Focus kinship remains the status carried through, not the excuse for, unresolved aggression.

structural_cues: 49:9 repeats repair of the between before and after a conditional anti-aggression intervention.
Justice and equity explicitly qualify the post-return repair, and 49:10 immediately generalizes brotherhood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the conditional sequence and its justice terms; I infer that 49:10 compresses that procedure into its general command. A live alternative is that 49:10 restates only the desired endpoint, leaving the preceding coercive procedure exceptional.

changed_reading.before: Brotherhood asks a neutral mediator to split the difference and restore harmony.
changed_reading.after: Brotherhood preserves both parties' membership while justice may require taking a side against active aggression until return makes equitable reconciliation possible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ridicule reduces another, faulting pushes a defect into view, yet the object is grammatically 'yourselves.' Beside focus brotherhood, interpersonal speech becomes reflexive injury: degrading a brother damages the speaker's own collective self and reopens the repaired tether.

activation_trace.role: Mockery supplies the social act that lowers a fellow member for laughter.
Faulting by insinuation supplies a speech wound aimed through another's defect.
The very self or identity makes the outward insult fold back into collective self-injury.
The focus tether explains how injury to another returns through the shared bond.

structural_cues: 49:11 says not to fault 'yourselves' while regulating one group's treatment of another.
The branchless roots at 49:11 words 27-28 add reciprocal nicknaming and labels only as structural cues; no branch identifiers are assigned to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interpersonal prohibitions with a reflexive object; I infer that 49:10's sibling bond makes the reflexive wording socially literal. A live alternative is that the plural reflexive is simply an idiom for 'one another' without a shared-self model.

changed_reading.before: Brotherhood mainly matters when an overt dispute needs mediation.
changed_reading.after: Brotherhood makes ordinary status speech self-referential: contempt for another member is damage within one's own relational identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Suspicion becomes covert tracing, absent-person speech, and finally consumptive corruption of a brother. This ordered escalation moves the focus command upstream: protective caution guards the bond's information ecology before antagonism becomes a visible fight requiring settlement.

activation_trace.role: Bad suspicion supplies the unverified inward seed of relational damage.
Secret pursuit of reports turns suspicion into covert acquisition.
Mentioning a person in absence turns hidden information into social circulation.
Corruption through tale-bearing makes consumption a mechanism that spreads damage between people.
The repeated tether identifies precisely what predatory speech consumes.
The repeated protective barrier answers the escalation with preventive guarding.
The focus settlement is expanded from an after-crisis act into an upstream maintenance practice.

structural_cues: 49:12 orders suspicion, spying, backbiting, the dead-brother flesh image, aversion, protective caution, return, and mercy.
The focus and 49:12 repeat brotherhood, protective caution, God, and mercy in closely related sequences.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered prohibitions and the consumption simile; I supply an upstream causal arrow from suspicious inference to bond-consuming circulation. A live alternative is that the offenses are parallel violations rather than stages in one escalation.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation begins after two sides openly fall out.
changed_reading.after: Reconciliation also means preventing conflict by governing suspicion, covert inquiry, and absent-person speech before they consume the brotherly bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: Peoples branch apart and can also mend a fissure; tribes are groups facing one another; recognition distinguishes by signs. The focus brotherhood therefore need not flatten social difference: repair turns differentiated branches toward face-to-face recognition, while protective caution displaces inherited rank as the measure of honor.

activation_trace.role: Branching and dispersal preserve real plurality within the social field.
Mending a fissure makes reunion compatible with prior branching.
Facing one thing toward another supplies encounter without collapse into sameness.
Recognition through trace or sign makes difference intelligible rather than hostile.
Honor supplies the status measure that the verse relocates away from group pedigree.
Self-placing caution becomes the alternative criterion of worth.
The focus tie permits distinct parties to remain connected across their middle.

structural_cues: 49:13 moves from one created pair to peoples and tribes, then to mutual recognition and a non-genealogical honor criterion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies branching, facing, recognition, honor, and caution; I infer that these specify what repaired brotherhood does with difference. A live alternative is that 49:13's universal human plurality should not be mapped directly onto the narrower believer relation in 49:10.

changed_reading.before: Brotherly reconciliation restores unity by minimizing distinctions.
changed_reading.after: Reconciliation can preserve branching identities, reorient them face to face, and convert difference into mutual recognition under a non-pedigree measure of worth.

context_deltas.mechanism: A claim to belief is contradicted, outward submission is available, and faith is pictured as not yet having entered hearts. This weakens a flat reading of the focus noun as a self-certified badge: 'believers are brothers' can function as a norm and diagnostic whose settled trust must become inwardly real.

activation_trace.role: Trusting assent is the contested state across claim, negation, and not-yet-entered faith.
External safety and freedom from harm supply a real but incomplete social threshold.
Entry into an interior turns faith from declaration into an inward arrival.
The heart supplies the interior in which trusting identity becomes operative.
Settled security anchors the thicker reading of the focus membership term.

structural_cues: 49:14 contrasts 'we believe,' 'you have not believed,' 'say we submit,' and faith not yet entering hearts.
The branchless 49:14 word at index 20 indicates no diminution and is retained only as structural support, without an invented branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit claim-versus-entry contrast; I infer that 49:10's nominal identity is normative and testable in conduct, including repair. A live alternative is that 49:14 addresses a distinct group and does not qualify the referent of 49:10 at all.

changed_reading.before: Anyone asserting the believer label automatically possesses the full brotherhood described.
changed_reading.after: The focus predicate can call a community into a trust-bearing identity whose inward reality is disclosed, and perhaps formed, by how it protects and repairs relations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Belief is followed by effort under strain with wealth and selves, then by truthfulness as realized word and deed. The focus imperative is thus not exhausted by conciliatory speech: faithful repair may require material expenditure, personal risk, time, and fulfilled commitments.

activation_trace.role: Exerting full capacity under hardship supplies the cost profile of enacted belief.
Possessed resources make commitment materially spendable rather than verbal only.
The living self supplies personal exposure alongside material cost.
Realizing promise in action makes costly follow-through the proof of speech.
Making the damaged relation sound is the focus task to which effort and resources are assigned.

structural_cues: 49:15 places lack of destabilizing doubt before effort with wealth and selves and closes with a truthfulness judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies costly exertion and enacted truthfulness; I infer that reconciliation is one arena in which such expenditure verifies the focus identity. A live alternative is that the effort concerns a different communal duty and does not specify the cost of mediation.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation is principally a good statement or persuasive conversation.
changed_reading.after: Repair may be the costly truth of brotherhood, requiring resources, exposure, and fulfilled commitments after conciliatory words end.

context_deltas.mechanism: Human beings burden the recipient by recounting their submission as a favor, while the direction reverses toward divine guidance as gift. The focus passive hope for mercy then resists mediator ownership: successful repair cannot become a moral invoice, prestige claim, or leverage over the reconciled parties.

activation_trace.role: Recounting a benefit until it burdens the recipient exposes the danger of weaponized beneficence.
Release without compensation supplies the contrasting gift logic.
A gentle gift sent toward one held in affection locates guidance outside human boasting.
Realized word and deed test whether the claimed benefit is truthful.
Hoped-for tenderness anchors the focus outcome as received mercy rather than mediator property.

structural_cues: 49:17 explicitly reverses who is conferring favor and makes guidance, not human self-presentation, the decisive gift.
The focus closes with a passive hope of receiving mercy rather than a claim that repairers manufacture it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the favor-burden and gift reversal; I infer that the same anti-leverage rule governs those who facilitate 49:10 repair. A live alternative is that 49:17 rebukes boasting about submission only, without addressing mediators.

changed_reading.before: The successful peacemaker earns standing over those helped.
changed_reading.after: Repair must remain non-possessive: it seeks mercy and guides gently without converting restored peace into debt owed to the mediator.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it materializes social ethics as tether, barrier, gap, and womb; it remains valid because every component is branch-backed in the focus ayah. Render it only as an exploratory model of protected relational space, not as a claim that the verse literally calls the community a womb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Brother tether, the between, protective caution, and mercy all occur in the focus sequence.

activation_trace.role: A tether gives the sibling relation a material bond that can strain or hold.
A widened gap supplies the tear or exposed distance within the bond.
A protective barrier supplies the enclosure that prevents further injury.
The womb supplies a bounded, sustaining interior for the hoped-for mercy.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives an abstract rule about social harmony.
changed_reading.after: The verse can be carried as a material model: mend a torn tether, close its dangerous exposure, and restore a protected interior in which related lives can remain viable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a corporeal extension beyond ordinary settlement language, but 49:12 repeats the focus brother root and explicitly supplies eating, flesh, death, and kinship-tissue branches. Render it as the packet's severe metaphor for absent-person harm, not as an ontology of the community or a literal ritual prescription.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names believers as brothers and commands repair of their connecting middle; 49:12 returns to the brother as consumable flesh.

activation_trace.role: Focus kinship supplies the living relation later exposed to consumption.
Literal taking of food gives absent speech its predatory action.
Woven fabric makes flesh a model for the interlaced tissue of relation.
Kinship cohesion directly links bodily tissue to the brother bond.
Loss of force and life marks the absent brother's inability to answer or defend the bond.

changed_reading.before: Repair reconnects two autonomous speakers after disagreement.
changed_reading.after: Brotherhood also obliges protection of the absent and voiceless: predatory speech consumes the woven kinship tissue that reconciliation would otherwise have to regrow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is deliberately branch-distant: it uses the packet's non-dominant H-D-D mapping beside dominant H-D-Y to contrast severe breaking with soothing a child. It remains anchored through the focus commands to restore soundness and seek tenderness, but downstream prose must label it a split-root heuristic, never a lexical equivalence for guidance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Restoring soundness and hoped-for tenderness in 49:10 can be tested against the opposed guidance, breaking, and gentling images activated at 49:17.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path supplies the dominant directional mode.
Severe breaking supplies the destructive pole that repair must avoid or contain.
Soothing rhythmic gentling supplies a non-destructive way to settle agitation.
Restored soundness anchors the contrast in the focus repair action.
Tender mercy selects gentling over person-breaking as the hoped-for horizon.

changed_reading.before: Reconciliation ends conflict by imposing a settlement.
changed_reading.after: An exploratory split-root reading asks whether repair guides agitated parties toward truth by gentling their motion without breaking the persons being corrected.

strongest_changes: 49:6 makes disclosure and affective steadiness prerequisites to closing the relational gap.
49:9 blocks false neutrality: brotherhood survives conflict while just repair may oppose the aggressing side until return.
49:11-12 move repair upstream into reflexive speech, suspicion, covert inquiry, and protection of the absent brother.
49:14-17 complicate membership and merit: faith must become inward and enacted, costly repair does not become the repairer's moral property.
summary.what_was_special: The restrictive identity claim, plural-to-dual grammar, and elastic 'between' make 49:10 a compressed social protocol. Context activation did not collapse into one reading: epistemic, judicial, affective, boundary, pluralist, corporeal, and gift-based mechanisms remain simultaneously live.
remaining_uncertainties: The transfer of 49:1-5 prophetic etiquette to mediation is coherent but analogical.
49:14 may qualify the focus membership term normatively, or may concern a separate group without narrowing 49:10.
The womb-tether and H-D-Y/H-D-D models are useful material heuristics but should not be promoted into lexical claims.
The knowledge and visibility cues in 49:16 and 49:18 sharpen hidden accountability but did not produce a distinct retained model beyond the stronger information and non-ownership readings.
